source_units: Verified source sentences; SCG complete BooksI-II discovery / III-IV held in canonical ittb-scg-s1..s23687 order
source_freshness: New ciphertext recovery control on corpus previously used as GDT832 reference; current frozen native Monarchia model is independent of this control

optimizer.initialization: Both arms share the first strict-compatible candidate and exact attempt count; invalid candidates never scored or saved as best; search RNG separately reset
optimizer.selection: Maximum discovery objective among eight starts; ties lowest start
optimizer.initialization_failure: Record all scheduled outcomes and INITIALIZATION_STOP, without selections or truth evaluation; no cap extension or fallback

key_recovery: Every identifiable observed role and output exact, using common GDT834 same-emission identifiability rules in both arms; unused slots excluded
strict_compatibility: Zero mandatory-W violations on discovery and held, using candidate-own complete W dictionary including inactive entries
decision_policy: STRICT recovery and paired benefit are separate claims; RELAXED failure never blocks a STRICT pass. Benefit requires STRICT passing all criteria, mean held word gain>=1pp, and no negative per-key gain

evaluation.gold: Exact original normalized source spelling, without u/v collapse or repair
evaluation.character_metric: 1 - summed wordwise edit distance / summed max paired lengths; known spaces excluded
evaluation.novelty: Against discovery plaintext; composed forms and unambiguous novel composed lemma occurrences
evaluation.secondary: Exact source sentences; active role/output accuracy; true-key objective; rejected proposal counts
evaluation.replicates: Three keys share one text split; no independent-corpus or population claim

blinding: All48restarts and six discovery selections locked before confirmation truth/held recovery. Initial paired compatibility checked without gold
claim_ceiling: Known fixed mandatory-W architecture, supplied atomic/word/sentence boundaries and nominal26L4S8W counts. No full suffix inverse, optional abbreviation rule or Voynich reading
